answers.question: platform 5: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own
answers.answer: Not so in OSM: the pedestrian tunnel w24788721 (layer -1) reaches platforms 4N and 5; stairs w25162077/w44123272/w115830078/w499992983 and lift n4911637960 reach platform 4N. Only in OSM, no plan seen.

answers.question: platform 5: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own (reached along the platform level only)
answers.answer: X-trafik's map shows a tunnel and has lifts in its legend, and OSM's tunnel w24788721 reaches 4N and 5, but no source says whether platform 5 has its own stairs or lift up from the tunnel. Not settled.
